boxes.description: a tensor of rank 2 or higher with a shape of [..., num_boxes, 4]. Dimensions except the last two are batch dimensions.

scores.description: a tensor of rank 1 or higher with a shape of [..., num_boxes].

max_output_size.description: a scalar integer `Tensor` representing the maximum number of boxes to be selected by non max suppression. Note that setting this value to a large number may result in OOM error depending on the system workload.

iou_threshold.description: a float representing the threshold for deciding whether boxes overlap too much with respect to IoU (intersection over union).

score_threshold.description: a float representing the threshold for box scores. Boxes with a score that is not larger than this threshold will be suppressed.

pad_to_max_output_size.description: whether to pad the output idx to max_output_size. Must be set to True when the input is a batch of images.

sorted_input.description: a boolean indicating whether the input boxes and scores are sorted in descending order by the score.

canonicalized_coordinates.description: if box coordinates are given as `[y_min, x_min, y_max, x_max]`, setting to True eliminate redundant computation to canonicalize box coordinates.

tile_size.description: an integer representing the number of boxes in a tile, i.e., the maximum number of boxes per image that can be used to suppress other boxes in parallel; larger tile_size means larger parallelism and potentially more redundant work.

output.description: a tensor with a shape of [..., num_boxes] representing the indices selected by non-max suppression. The leading dimensions are the batch dimensions of the input boxes. All numbers are within [0, num_boxes). For each image (i.e., idx[i]), only the first num_valid[i] indices (i.e., idx[i][:num_valid[i]]) are valid. num_valid: a tensor of rank 0 or higher with a shape of [...] representing the number of valid indices in idx. Its dimensions are the batch dimensions of the input boxes.
